after.rosterkit/notices.py:
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from datetime import date
from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def _check_owner(pupil: Student, marks: List[Mark]):
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != pupil.student_id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id!r} does not "
                f"belong to {pupil.student_id!r}"
            )


def _compose(pupil: Student, days: List[date]) -> str:
    count = len(days)
    unit = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    listed = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    name = f"{pupil.first_name} {pupil.last_name}"
    head = f"{name} missed {count} {unit} of class."
    return f"{head}\nDates absent: {listed}"


# ---
def absence_notice(pupil: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]):
    """Notice of absent days; ValueError on bad input."""
    marks = list(marks)
    _check_owner(pupil, marks)
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ValueError("no absences to write about")
    return _compose(pupil, days)
after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

PUPIL = Student("7", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


def mark(day, status="absent", pupil="7"):
    return Mark(pupil, date(2026, 9, day), status)


class AbsenceNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names_count_and_ordered_dates(self):
        marks = [mark(9), mark(2), mark(4, "present")]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ada Lovelace", text)
        self.assertIn("2 days", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-02, 2026-09-09", text)

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, [mark(3)])
        self.assertIn("1 day ", text)

    def test_excused_days_are_left_out(self):
        marks = [mark(3), mark(4, "excused")]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertNotIn("2026-09-04", text)

    def test_other_students_mark_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark(3), mark(4, pupil="8")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [mark(3, "present")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
